tasks.title: Remove narration from config, types, init and BRAND
tasks.description:
Round 19 removes narration and ntfy. The consumers (run.ts, stream-filter.ts — task #139) and the modules (narration.ts, commands/narrate.ts, lib/ — task #140) are already gone. This task removes the config, types, init prompts/hook scripts, and BRAND constants.

Remove:
- src/types.ts: the `narration` field from CairnConfig and its checks in isCairnConfig (~lines 57-61). isCairnConfig must no longer require `narration`.
- src/config.ts: narrationRaw parsing and the narration defaults in loadConfig (~28-29, 50-54); the CAIRN_NARRATION_ENABLED / CAIRN_NARRATION_VOICE / CAIRN_NTFY_TOPIC env exports (~151-153).
- src/commands/init.ts: the narrationEnabled / narrationVoice / ntfyTopic fields of the config-prompt type (~69-71) and their defaults (~209-211); the TTS / voice / ntfy prompts (~257-263); the `narration` key in the generated cairn.json (~276); NARRATE_SH, SPEAK_SH, NOTIFY_SH (from ~416), NARRATION_HOOKS, writeNarrationHooks, installNarrationHooks, and the installNarrationHooks call in the init flow (~819); any imports that become unused.
- src/brand.ts: BRAND.socket and BRAND.pidFile. Rewrite the STANDING RULE comment (~lines 6-10) to name only dataDir / configFile with findDataDir() / findConfigFile() — drop socket/pidFile and findNarrationSocketPath / findNarrationPidFile.
- Delete this repo's tracked .claude/hooks/narrate.sh, speak.sh and notify.sh (git rm). If .claude/hooks/ is then empty it simply disappears. Do NOT add any init migration that deletes such scripts in other projects — they exit 0 when the socket is missing and are inert (deliberate decision).

Old configs must keep loading: a cairn.json that still has a `narration` block (this repo's does until the user removes it by hand after the round) must load without error or warning; the loader simply ignores the key.

Required tests (TDD — write first):
(1) test/config.test.ts: loadConfig on a cairn.json containing `"narration": {"enabled": false, "voice": "bf_emma", "ntfyTopic": "x"}` succeeds, emits no warning (spy on console.warn / stderr as the suite does elsewhere), and the result has no `narration` property;
(2) test/types.test.ts: isCairnConfig accepts a config object with no `narration` key;
(3) test/commands/init.test.ts: init's generated cairn.json has no `narration` key, and init prompts no longer ask about TTS/voice/ntfy.
Also update/remove existing tests asserting narration defaults, NARRATION_HOOKS, writeNarrationHooks / installNarrationHooks, the CAIRN_NARRATION_* / CAIRN_NTFY_TOPIC env vars, or BRAND.socket/pidFile (check test/brand.test.ts).

Afterward: `grep -rn -i 'narrat\|ntfy\|BRAND.socket\|pidFile' src test` returns nothing except test/process.test.ts's sample process name 'narrate', which stays.

CONSTRAINTS (self-modifying round, binary pinned): do NOT modify cairn.json (including its healthCheck and its narration block — the user removes that by hand after the round), install.sh, or package.json's build script. Never run `cairn round`, `cairn hook`, `cairn init` (or `bun src/index.ts round|hook|init`) against the project root — temp dirs only. Do not run ./install.sh. Use TDD: write/adjust the failing test first, see it fail, then make it pass. Both `bun run typecheck` and `bun test` must be green at the end.
tasks.notes:
TDD: wrote the 4 new tests first, then ran
`bun test test/config.test.ts test/types.test.ts test/commands/init.test.ts -t 'narration'` -> 4 fail, e.g.
`(fail) loadConfig > loads a legacy cairn.json with a narration block, silently ignoring the key` (expect('narration' in config).toBe(false) -> Received: true),
`(fail) isValidConfig > accepts a config object with no narration key`,
`(fail) promptForConfig > generated config has no narration key and never asks about TTS/voice/ntfy`,
`(fail) runInit > generated cairn.json has no narration key`.

Source changes:
- src/types.ts: dropped CairnConfig.narration and its isValidConfig checks.
- src/config.ts: dropped narrationRaw parsing/defaults and CAIRN_NARRATION_ENABLED/VOICE/CAIRN_NTFY_TOPIC exports. A legacy `narration` key in cairn.json is silently ignored (no warning).
- src/commands/init.ts: removed narration fields from ConfigDefaults/getConfigDefaults, the TTS/voice/ntfy prompts, the `narration` key in generated cairn.json, NARRATE_SH/SPEAK_SH/NOTIFY_SH, NARRATION_HOOKS, writeNarrationHooks, installNarrationHooks and its call in runInit. InstallOptions/sameContent stay (used by slash-command/agent/settings installers). promptForConfig is now 7 base prompts + reviewPostTask.
- src/brand.ts: removed BRAND.socket/pidFile; STANDING RULE comment names only dataDir/configFile with findDataDir()/findConfigFile().
- git rm .claude/hooks/{narrate,speak,notify}.sh (dir now gone). No init migration for other projects (deliberate).

Tests: removed narration fields/assertions from config, types, init, brand (now pins exact BRAND key set), agent-prompt, post-task-reviewer, run, round tests; runInit/promptForConfig mock answer arrays shortened by one prompt; deleted installNarrationHooks describe and narration-sub-prompt tests.
bun run typecheck clean; bun test 1154 pass / 0 fail.

Remaining grep hits for narrat|ntfy in test/ are only absence-pin tests (index.test.ts, stream-filter.test.ts, run.test.ts from #139/#140, plus this task's required legacy-config/no-narration-key tests); src/ is clean.
Not done (out of file scope): CLAUDE.md still mentions narrate command, lib/ narration scripts, src/narration.ts, BRAND.socket/pidFile and findNarrationSocketPath (lines ~44, 79, 110, 116) - needs a docs cleanup.
